name: motif_split_phoneme
description:
Split a spelling into a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if a spelling marks a real contrast; otherwise keep it as another spelling of the phoneme. Then add the new phoneme to its natural classes and give it features (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages the move of one spelling of a phoneme into a new phoneme of its own, which undoes a merge. The phoneme keeps its other spellings, and the new phoneme starts with no natural class and no features. It refuses a spelling an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-split-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme that has the spelling now.

representation.description: The spelling to move out, such as o.
